scope: isolated primitive; not a decoder or model adoption

recurrence.root: I = B(authenticated embedding); Z = embedding is negative zero
recurrence.update: J = I + B(actual addend); checked signed 65-bit addition, then signed 64-bit narrowing
recurrence.zero_tag: Znew = (J == 0 and I == 0 and Z == 1 and addend == negative zero)
recurrence.view: binary16 RNE(J * 2^-24), gradual underflow; use Znew for exact zero
recurrence.overflow: reject signed integer overflow or FP16 RNE infinity; abs(value) >= 65520 rejects
recurrence.residual_ownership: Output state, not the rounded FP16 view, is the next residual operand.

protocol.clear: synchronous active-high clear_i, priority over transfers
protocol.start: idle only; known count 1..VECTOR_SIZE; first input no earlier than the next cycle
protocol.invalid_count: start_ready_o remains low; caller must diagnose invalid count, not wait indefinitely or report success
protocol.input: in_valid_i && in_ready_o accepts exactly one state/addend pair
protocol.output: one registered paired result after input acceptance; one-entry elastic output; one element per cycle when unstalled
protocol.backpressure: all output payload, index, last and fault fields stable while valid and not ready
protocol.completion: busy_o clears only when the last result transfers
protocol.fault: faulted result is last; numeric fields are non-admissible zeros; no later inputs or starts until reset/clear
protocol.unknowns: participating payload X/Z produces code 1 on an accepted input; unknown valid/ready/control prevents a transfer and must be diagnosed by the owning harness
protocol.cancellation: reset/clear discards all pending transfers; partial vectors are not state parents

fault_codes.1: nonfinite or unknown participating input payload

route_boundary: freeze source/header/contracts; import independent oracle/codec without calling arithmetic; compile and elaborate only; never invoke a simulator executable
